name: Dixie J. Huxtable
prior_offices: Converse County assessor (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official assessor page)
background: Dixie J. Huxtable is the Converse County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official assessor page lists her in that office, and the official general election summary lists her as the winner of the assessor race.
